answer_text:
Here are some funny, quirky, and genuinely weird habits that many people have — you might even recognize yourself in a few of these!

---

### 🎨 1. Doodling During Phone Calls
There are a handful of people who doodle during phone calls to help keep them focused — and sometimes, they don't even know they're doing it until they're off the phone!

---

### 🗣️ 2. Talking to Inanimate Objects
A lot of us have the habit of talking to inanimate objects — like apologizing to a table after accidentally bumping into it, or yelling at a laptop when it decides to freeze right in the middle of something important.

---

### 🚿 3. Rehearsing Arguments in the Shower
The shower seems to be the perfect place to rehearse arguments. It's frustrating how the most brilliant comebacks for past conflicts always seem to surface while you're shampooing your hair — long after the moment has passed.

---

### 🛋️ 4. Faking Sleep to Avoid People
The moment some people hear footsteps approaching, they instantly fake sleep like they're in a coma — whether they're trying to avoid an awkward conversation or just perfecting their acting skills, they suddenly transform into the deepest sleeper imaginable!

---

### 📦 5. Folding Trash Neatly
Some people fold their trash — any pieces of paper, foil, chip bags, candy wrappers, paper towels, or gum wrappers. Anything that can be folded once they're done with the contents inside gets folded into a neat square.

---

### 🐕 6. Telling Objects to "Stay"
Some people have a habit of setting down a breakable object and telling it to "stay" out loud, like you would to a dog. They never thought it was weird until someone saw them do it — reasoning that they're telling it not to fall or get lost, even though the objects couldn't listen if they wanted to!

---

### 🥤 7. Tapping a Can Before Opening It
Some people tap the lid of a can three times before opening it when drinking Coke or beer. One person had no idea they were even doing it until someone at a gathering asked about the habit and assumed it was for luck — so they just went with that explanation.

---

### 🥛 8. Shaking Store-Bought Milk
Some people shake milk jugs before pouring a glass. One person was raised on a dairy farm where it was necessary with fresh milk, and they were about 30 years old before someone asked why — at which point they realized they didn't actually need to with store-bought milk!

---

### 👂 9. Folding One's Ear While Reading
Some people fold their ear over backwards while they read, and it becomes such a habit that they don't even realize they're doing it until someone points it out.

---

### 🍽️ 10. Eating Foods Separately
Some people eat things on their plate separately — for example, eating all the chicken first, then all the broccoli. They often don't realize this is considered unusual until someone else points it out.

---

### 🧴 11. Eating Strange Non-Food Items (Pica)
On a more extreme end, some people have a habit of eating non-food items like dirt or chalk, which is known as **pica**.

---

As humans, we're all odd in our own ways, but many of our tendencies are more common than you might think! So if you recognized yourself in any of these, you're definitely not alone. 😄
